events.label: Jet engine falls on Darko house
events.description: A jet engine falls from a clear sky and crushes the Darko house - into Donnie's empty bedroom, on a night when he should have been in it.

events.label: Donnie lured out by Frank; survives engine
events.description: Donnie wasn't in bed: a voice lured him out - Frank, a figure in a monstrous rabbit suit, who told him the world would end in twenty-eight days.

events.label: Tangent universe forms around artifact
events.description: The explanation the film circles: a broken offshoot of reality has formed around the fallen engine, and Donnie has twenty-eight days to close it.

events.label: Donnie floods school
events.description: Donnie floods his school by breaking the water main - one of the acts the rabbit's countdown seems to be steering him toward.

events.label: Cinema / Jim Cunningham house fire chain
events.description: A fire at the cinema forces a screening into Frank's house, and the blaze that follows burns down motivational speaker Jim Cunningham's home - the chain of chaos keeps growing.

events.label: Philosophy of time travel / PoT book
events.description: A book, The Philosophy of Time Travel, appears on Donnie's shelf - its half-mad chapters explain artifacts, receivers, and what must be done.

events.label: Gretchen killed; Frank shot
events.description: At the story's darkest turn, Frank's car kills Donnie's girlfriend Gretchen - and Donnie shoots Frank dead, unmasking the rabbit.

events.label: Donnie returns jet engine to primary through portal
events.description: Donnie finally understands: the engine is the anomaly, and it must go back. He sends it through to the world where it came from.

events.label: Tangent collapses into primary
events.description: The broken offshoot of reality folds back into the world it split from - twenty-eight days erased as if they never ran.

events.label: Donnie dies in bed under engine in primary
events.description: Back in the restored world, Donnie is in bed when the engine falls - laughing at the end, because he chose this to save Gretchen and everyone else.

events.label: Others wake with residual grief/laughter
events.description: In the morning, people who never knew him wake weeping or laughing - carrying some residue of a boy who never existed for them.

events.label: Jet engine destroys bedroom; Donnie outside
events.description: The engine through the roof, and Donnie's bed empty beneath it.

events.label: Frank 28-day countdown
events.description: Frank's warning stands over the whole story: twenty-eight days, six hours, forty-two minutes, twelve seconds.

events.label: Engine returned; Donnie dies in bed
events.description: The engine goes back where it belongs, and the story's two worlds fold into one.

events.label: Jet engine falls; Donnie not in bed
events.description: The engine falls on a night in October - and Donnie is not in his bed.

events.label: Frank rabbit guides Donnie
events.description: Frank the rabbit steers Donnie through the weeks - hectoring, prophetic, and eventually unmasked as a boy Donnie knows.

events.label: Tangent universe opens
events.description: Reality splits around the fallen engine - a damaged copy of the world running alongside the real one.

events.label: Living Receiver role
events.description: Donnie is the Receiver - the one person the broken world has chosen to fix it, whether he wants the job or not.

events.label: Manipulated people (Grandma Death etc.)
events.description: Certain people are Manipulated - pulled by unseen strings toward the Receiver: Grandma Death, the teacher, Gretchen, Frank himself.

events.label: Donnie returns to die in bed; close tangent
events.description: Donnie's choice, made knowingly: die in the restored world so that the broken one never has to happen.

events.label: Primary universe restored; engine unexplained
events.description: The real world carries on as if nothing happened - one jet engine, one dead boy, and no explanation that science will accept.

ruleEffects.effect: Living Receiver returns artifact; tangent must collapse
Primary death of Donnie closes consistently

outcome.summary: Tangent collapses; jet engine returned; Donnie dies in primary so others live.
